### Lane

The subject is `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`'s exit-4 verdict — the seat's own stamped-write tool.

`SKILL.md` puts 「governed 面全量 … 非门禁的 `scripts/pm/**`(PM 循环工具)」 in the skills row. Read from `origin/main` in this act, ⛔ not from the working checkout — this seat had a stale checkout earlier today and cited a line that had already been retired, so charter reads are now taken with `git show origin/main:<path>`.

### ⛔ Why no grade

「skills 车道 finding 由该席自分诊,全仓轮跳过」. The `finding` label stays and the grade is that seat's first act, ⛔ not this one's. This is the defined waiting shape, ⛔ not a half-state.

### ⭐ Adjacent, ⛔ not duplicate — and this seat hit it today

objectstack-ai/objectstack#19350 (filed by this seat) reports the **opposite** failure of the same read-back: it returned `identical` for a body the platform rewrote in 482 places. This card reports the read-back crying wolf; objectstack-ai/objectstack#19350 reports it staying silent. **Same comparison, two directions** — whoever fixes either should read both, because a fix that only widens tolerance makes objectstack-ai/objectstack#19350 worse.

⏱️ Lived instance, this shift: **ten** exit-4s, every one verified substance-identical by hand read-back. The root cause of that count was a stale checkout missing `f93beea0a6`; after updating it, the footer-relocation case **still** exits 4 — so this card survives that fix and is ⛔ not closed by it.
